usage.darkBands: navy bg, brightWhite text, marigold highlights

accent.use: semi-bold italic, accent words in headlines ONLY — never full headlines, subheads, or body

typography.webFallbacks: Montserrat, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif · Spectral, Georgia, serif

rules: never rotate, recolor, distort, frame, or add drop shadow
full-color logo never on busy or dark backgrounds (use white one-color version on navy/black)
clearance = half the symbol height on all sides
place top-left or bottom-left; don't center unless unavoidable
logo.note: Stagwell.AI wordmark treatment for the demo: STAGWELL in navy + .AI in light blue (per wireframes) until an official lockup is supplied

accessibility: minimum 44px hit targets; body text ≥14px; check contrast on marigold (use navy text, never white)
